evaluation_policy: The documented default selects the causally first generation-stage prompt and latent canvas, preserving distinct downstream stage prompts and canvas dimensions. Sampler dependencies through actual reference conditioning count toward causal ordering.
ModelSamplingFlux width/height calibration mirrors the chosen primary canvas; upstream patch formula explicitly depends on image area.
Seed fans out to every active sampling stage.
Manual-required slots and genuinely absent inputs are not counted as automatically correct.
Paired polarity contracts learned from upstream are recorded, but not injected into the engine object_info-less comparison.
